spec.title: Outbound health
spec.description: DOWN: Xray alive=0. DEGRADED: burst window contains failed probes. UP: alive with no failed probes; ordinary observatory exposes only alive. Missing data stays missing.

spec.title: Selection state changes
spec.description: Number of observed 0/1 transitions across primary, fallback and override series in each minute. One target replacement can cause multiple transitions. Missing data and minute boundaries limit completeness; this is not a connection log. The window is centered on each minute; the latest bucket is incomplete.

spec.title: Outbound selected time
spec.description: Fraction of observed samples in which a target was selected, not its share of traffic. Multiple selected targets can sum above 100%. Missing scrapes do not count as zero.

spec.title: Selected outbounds
spec.description: Primary target membership plus fallback and override activity. Fallback uses its configured outbound tag; override has no outbound tag. Gray means confirmed inactive; gaps mean unavailable or unknown data.

spec.title: Outbound latency
spec.description: Burst: mean RTT of successful samples in the observation window. Ordinary observatory: last successful delay. Seconds; no fabricated values on failure.

spec.title: Collection duration
spec.description: Settings and server/status requests start in parallel. gRPC and expvars start after settings completes, without waiting for server/status. Source durations overlap and are shown without stacking. API is the elapsed span until both API requests finish, not their sum. Runtime is max(gRPC, expvars). Total is the end-to-end duration measured by Prometheus; source durations cannot be added to reconstruct it.

spec.title: Balancer availability
spec.description: A selected target or fallback resolves to a runtime outbound. Structural availability, not a test of internet access.

spec.title: Burst failed probes
spec.description: Failed fraction in the current burst window, not a cumulative counter. Empty measurements remain absent.

spec.title: Go runtime memory
spec.description: Go runtime memory values; neither is process RSS.

spec.title: GC pause time
spec.description: GC pause seconds per elapsed second, displayed as a percentage.

spec.title: Xray version
spec.description: Xray version reported by the panel status API. This does not independently attest the running binary.

spec.title: Panel version
spec.description: Version reported by the running 3x-ui panel. Omitted if unavailable in this panel version.

spec.title: Xray state
spec.description: Process state reported by the panel, not a connectivity probe. Only the active state is displayed. Missing or unknown state remains No data.

spec.title: Prometheus target
spec.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the exporter; independent of upstream collection success.

spec.title: Metrics sources
spec.description: Successful / present sources. Numeric value is the success fraction, used for color. With the upcoming exporter all three source rows are always present. Older exporters may expose fewer sources. No data when the target is down. API: settings/status; gRPC: runtime outbounds/balancers; expvars: traffic, memory/GC and observation.

spec.expr:
(sum(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}) / count(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}))
* on() group_left(summary)
label_join(
  count_values("healthy", sum(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}))
  * on() group_left(total)
  count_values("total", count(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"})),
  "summary", "/", "healthy", "total"
)
and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

spec.title: Balancers
spec.description:
Available: Balancers with a usable selected target or configured fallback according to the exporter. This is structural availability, not an end-to-end Internet probe. Includes balancers currently using fallback. Open availability history for detail.

Unavailable: Balancers without an available selected target or usable fallback. A nonzero value calls for investigation. Open availability history.

Fallback: Balancers currently using their fallback. This can preserve service while primary selection is empty. A warning about operating mode, not necessarily an outage. Absent fallback metrics remain No data.

Override: Balancers currently using a manually overridden target. This is an operating mode, not automatically a failure. Open selected outbounds to identify the affected balancer.

spec.expr: sum(xui_balancer_outbound_available{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 1) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_selected{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",role="fallback"}) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_selected{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",role="override"}) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_available{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

spec.title: Balancers availability and attention
spec.description: Above zero: available balancers, including those served by fallback. Below zero: unavailable balancers and active fallback, stacked as independent attention indicators. These are not a partition: an available balancer can also use fallback, so do not subtract the lower stack from the upper one. Override is shown separately in the summary. Counts describe sampled states, not replacement events or outage duration. Missing source data produces gaps. Open selected outbounds to identify the affected balancer.

spec.expr: sum(xui_balancer_outbound_available{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 1) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_available{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_selected{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",role="fallback"}) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

spec.title: Total traffic Download / Upload
spec.description: Above zero: client download throughput (downlink rate into inbounds). Below zero: client upload throughput (uplink rate into inbounds). Stated in bits per second. Missing or disabled counters remain absent. Open detail views to inspect individual inbound channels.

spec.title: Observed outbounds
spec.description:
UP: Observed outbounds that are alive and, when burst probe samples exist, have no failed samples. This is the observation population, not all configured outbounds.

DEGRADED: Alive observed outbounds with failed samples in the current burst observation window. They can still carry traffic. Ordinary observatory does not provide this degradation detail.

DOWN: Observed outbounds reported not alive. Open outbound health for tags and timing. An observation result does not by itself prove which traffic was affected.

spec.expr: sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 2) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 1) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 0) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

spec.title: Observed outbounds health history
spec.description: Above zero: UP outbounds. Below zero: DEGRADED and DOWN, stacked. These three states partition the observed population at each sample; their absolute counts sum to the number of observed outbounds. DEGRADED requires burst probe samples. Missing observations or failed collection produce gaps, never healthy zeroes. Open outbound health to see tags, latency and quality.

spec.expr: sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 2) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 1) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 0) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

spec.title: Exporter process memory
spec.description: Resident Set Size (RSS) memory from OS process stats and live Go heap allocations.

spec.title: Exporter CPU & Goroutines
spec.description: Process CPU utilization rate and active Go runtime goroutines.

spec.title: Connection stats
spec.description: Current open network sockets reported by the panel environment

spec.title: Online clients
spec.description: Current active client sessions reported by the panel

spec.title: Availability history
spec.description: Remote cluster node availability history over time. Green indicates online based on master panel heartbeat probes; red indicates offline. Missing data indicates collection failure or unconfigured nodes.

spec.title: Connected nodes
spec.description: Online / total remote cluster nodes. Based on master panel heartbeat status. Numeric value is the availability fraction used for color. No data when no remote nodes are configured or panel API is unreachable.

spec.expr:
(sum(xui_node_online{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}) / count(xui_node_online{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}))
* on() group_left(summary)
label_join(
  count_values("healthy", sum(xui_node_online{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}))
  * on() group_left(total)
  count_values("total", count(xui_node_online{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"})),
  "summary", "/", "healthy", "total"
)
and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

spec.title: Latency
spec.description: Round-trip time (RTT) between master panel and remote cluster nodes. Based on master panel heartbeat probes. Missing data indicates offline nodes or heartbeat probe timeout.

spec.title: Inventory
spec.description: Inventory of remote cluster nodes: Xray core process state, system uptime, configured inbounds, and software versions.

spec.title: Resources
spec.description: Remote cluster node CPU and memory utilization percent over time. Missing data indicates offline nodes.

spec.title: Throughput
spec.description: Aggregated inbound network throughput per remote cluster node. Based on inbound traffic counters reported by the master panel database. Step intervals reflect remote node heartbeat synchronization cadence.

spec.title: Traffic volume
spec.description: Total inbound traffic volume transferred per remote cluster node over the selected time range. Sourced from the master panel database.

spec.title: Status
spec.description: Configured client accounts in 3x-ui database by lifecycle state

spec.title: Sessions
spec.description: Concurrent active client sessions over time

spec.title: Outbound quality & health
spec.description: Consolidated runtime health, network latency, jitter, probe reliability, and overall quality score for outbounds in the selected balancer.

spec.expr:
8 * (
  sum by (outbound) (rate(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
  and on (outbound)
  topk(6, (sum by (outbound) (increase(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__range]))) > 10 * 1024 * 1024)
)

8 * clamp_min(
  sum(rate(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
  -
  sum(
    sum by (outbound) (rate(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
    and on (outbound)
    topk(6, (sum by (outbound) (increase(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__range]))) > 10 * 1024 * 1024)
  ),
  0
)
